before: A drawing group with a nested group, a hidden member, or a trailing extension list projects as a placeholder, and nested members cannot be selected.
after: Nested, turned, flipped, and hidden group members project and paint from the same source XML, and nested shapes can be selected for the existing shape edits.
reason: Only drawing projection, paint, and derived story lists change. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged, and nested-member edits use the existing shape operations on the member node.
